title: Unfreeze the submit button
summary: A .Result deadlock on the UI thread, and why the handler stays async void.

turns.user: app locks up when I hit submit. not sometimes. every time

assistant.body: .Result blocks the UI thread while the continuation is waiting for that same UI thread. Classic deadlock, so it becomes await.

turns.user: that's an event handler though. you can't += something that returns Task

assistant.body: My mistake, that signature no longer matches EventHandler. The handler stays async void and catches its own exceptions instead. I also gave it a 10 second cancellation.

turns.user: 10s is too tight on bad wifi, make it 30. also the log wording, everywhere else says "submit failed"

assistant.body: Both are one line each, so sed handles them: the timeout goes to 30 seconds and the message matches the rest.
